## Introduction

[What have we been watching on Netflix?](https://github.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/blob/main/data/2025/2025-07-29/readme.md) 

question: How does the performance of globally available content compare to regionally restricted titles? Do global releases consistently outperform regional ones?

variables of interest:
  - title
  - available_globally
  - hours_viewed
  - views

## Visualizations


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
movies_clean <- movies |>
  filter(title != "Title") |>
  mutate(available_globally = as.factor(available_globally),
         hours_viewed_100000s = hours_viewed / 100000,
         views_100000s = views / 100000)

movies_clean |> group_by(available_globally) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = available_globally, y = views_100000s)) +
  geom_boxplot()
```
